APPROVED FLOW-BATTERY BULK Al END-PLATE SUPPLY, issue81,2026-10-18. Zhang et al.2025 DOI10.1039/D4EB00027G, public paper https://www.db-thueringen.de/servlets/MCRFileNodeServlet/dbt_derivate_00067974/D4EB00027G.pdf . Source design uses aluminium endplates; workbook specifies10mm thickness but buys batterycurrentcollectorfoil. Replace that supplier at the same1kg finishedplate/kg endplate with a scopedbulkplate reference: genericwroughtAl supply,aluminium sheet/plate rolling service and averageAl product finishing service. No additional lithium-ion battery,highpuritycollector architecture orAlLi alloy is required. Preserve installedHFB49.49331859090909kg andOFB26.731447961538468kg endplates, existingarea/count and nominal40kWh design. Actual plate alloy is unspecified; use the genericwroughtalloy supplymix as a declared forming-compatible proxy, not a certified6061plate or pureprimaryAl claim.95% totalmetalretention is an explicitengineeringassumption,test90-100%; buy1/0.95kgAl and matchinggrossrolling service,finish1kg netplate,dispose1/0.95-1kg mixed manufacturingoffcut. Native metalworking services exclude the separately requiredmetal feed; do not treat servicekg as anotherkg retainedAl. Generic hazardous-incineration is a manufacturingloss-fate proxy,not an endorsed commercialAlscrap route or an addedrecoverycredit. Actual net/gross dimensions,drilledholes,bolting tolerance,alloyingcomposition,processingyield and futureweight reduction need engineeringverification. This change replaces a foilmanufacturing proxy; it does not assert the finishedplate masses are optimized or sourcefullyreproduced. No separatefullsystemreplacement or duplicatedplate purchase. Preserve source exclusionofbatteryEOL and all other subsystemrecipes; no native,runtime,YAML or primary-secondaryshare edits.

CLIC_snapshot.comment:
C151: bulk aluminium plate replaces the battery-collector-foil placeholder. The approved one-kg bulk-plate reference is expanded directly into this existing one-kg end-plate record: 1 kg generic wrought alloy, 1 kg rolling service and 1 kg average working service. No extra foreground 5% stock or incineration is added; native embedded replacement stock, scrap and treatment remain once. Native 0.2-6 mm rolling is a qualified proxy for the inherited 10 mm plate. The 0.00298 kg/kg unallocated stock residual is not forced closed. Alloy-product kilograms are nominal stock, not elemental assays. Existing consumer identities and plate quantities remain unchanged; no duplicate supplier.

Historical source/curation record:
the thickness of the end plate is 10 mm, which is similar to that of Al foill. 

The original inventory is presented in: "Zhang, S., Ramanujam, A. S., Arvidsson, R., Michieletto, A., & Schubert, U. S. (2025). Prospective life cycle assessment of organic redox flow batteries. EES Batteries. doi: https://doi.org/10.1039/D4EB00027G"

Curated planning decision: R133-R152:C149-C151-C190. New revision only; original published version preserved.
